releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10

Beta 10 adds **global physical-controller profiles** and improves Mophun sound and game speed.

Open **Settings → Physical controller profiles** to edit the global mapping or create reusable profiles for buttons and both sticks. Assign them to games from the manager or each game's Controls page. Graphics, touch layouts and physical mappings stay independent. Existing per-game overrides take priority; shared changes apply the next time the game opens. Profiles are included in library backups.

Mophun sound is now enabled for every game. Short BEEP effects and `vBeep` are supported, and PCM follows pause and emulation speed. A common phone-model execution budget reduces excessive speed in CPU-dependent games such as the supplied Boulder Dash and Lemtris versions.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place. Back up important saves before updating or switching architecture. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 9
releases.body:
Beta 9 adds **independent right-stick mapping** for physical controllers.

Open **Controls → Controller mapping → Sticks** to assign the right stick’s directions and diagonals to phone keys, soft keys or Fire. **Identify** detects right-stick movement; pressing R3 remains a separate input. Bindings are saved per game, and existing profiles keep their settings with the new directions unbound.

The shared input path supports Java ME, Mophun and Symbian/N-Gage. This maps stick directions to digital keys; it does not add proportional analog camera support to games.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place.

Tested with automated input and a virtual joystick on Retroid; physical dual-stick hardware testing remains pending. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 8
releases.body:
Beta 8 fixes Lara's black/striped appearance and loading-screen text showing through her model in **Tomb Raider: Underworld 3D**. The cause was incorrect transparency when transferring M3G rendering to the Java ME screen.

Startup errors now show the original game exception instead of only `InvocationTargetException`.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and the combined Symbian runtime.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Both require Android 10+ and update the existing app without uninstalling.

The reported **Crash Titans 1.3.7 Sony S700i JAR** was also checked. Its code and packed resources are inconsistent; the same reader fails on ordinary Java outside AbyssME. This release does not make that particular JAR playable.

Checks: 427 JVM tests per build, focused Retroid renderer tests, signed APK update and first-room checks. This is not complete-game acceptance. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7

## Separate graphics and control profiles

- **Settings → Graphics profiles** and **Settings → Control profiles** now have
  independent global defaults, named profiles and assignments. Each game can
  select one graphics profile and one control profile. Changing or resetting
  one category leaves the other intact; extra Gamepad buttons remain available.
- Graphics profiles include supported scaling, smoothing, built-in xBRZ/CRT,
  FSR/sharpness, interpolation, LCD filters and capture settings. Java GPU and
  Mophun support GPU effects; Symbian uses its supported host display options.
  Integer scaling falls back to Fit on Symbian. Java-only geometry options are
  identified in the editor's support information.
- Beta 6 combined profiles split automatically: LCD inheritance and exceptions
  move to graphics, while touch settings remain in controls. Other existing
  graphics remain explicit overrides. Reset the relevant category's overrides
  when you want existing games to inherit a shared setup.
- Both catalogs, including unassigned profiles, travel through library backups.
  Phone backups retain portable game definitions. Picture Keep/Undo preserves

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 6
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 6

## Shared profiles and extra touch buttons

- Set global touch/LCD defaults and create named profiles from **Settings →
  Profiles / Global defaults**. Link individual games or assign a profile to
  several prepared games. Edit a shared profile once; linked games use it on
  their next launch.
- Keep per-game exceptions, inspect which profile supplies each setting, and
  reset individual overrides. Existing game settings stay unchanged on upgrade;
  explicitly reset their touch/LCD overrides to adopt shared settings.
- Add up to twelve independent Gamepad buttons in **Edit touch layout → Extra**.
  Choose a key and label, size, opacity and separate portrait/landscape positions.
  Additional buttons are included in shared profiles.
- Library backups carry profile definitions and assignments. Phone backups carry
  portable per-game definitions. Restore preserves destination profiles when
  names or identities conflict.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.3.0
releases.body:
Anka Native 0.3.0 draws the tree canopies, plants and the arch beside Link's door that 0.2.2 left out, adds a 3D resolution setting, a faster Prepare on the phone and three new languages.
It is still slow: Kokiri Forest runs at about 14 fps on our test phone, and frames are slower than in 0.2.2 where the new content is on screen. The change for the Adreno 840 hang (#5) is untested because we have no Adreno 840.

"Tested on the phone" below means our only test phone: POCO F8 Pro (Adreno 830, 12 GB, Android 16 / HyperOS). "Tests only" means automated tests or a computer, not a phone.

### What is new

- **Mesh-drawn content is now drawn.** Kokiri Forest's tree canopies, grass, ferns, flowers and the arch beside Link's door, and the Deku Tree upper floor's floor that was invisible ([#6](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/6)). 0.2.2 skipped these draws on Turnip drivers. Your pack gets the needed shaders through an automatic update (see *After updating*). Tested on the phone with Anka Turnip: no draws skipped in Kokiri Forest and the Deku Tree's upper floor. Not tested on an Adreno 7xx, and not with Qualcomm's own driver.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.2
releases.body:
### Security fix

- **The launcher no longer takes control commands from other apps** ([#7](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/7)).
  - Before this release, any app on the phone could ask Anka Native's launcher to install or pick a GPU driver, add a game, start Prepare, or export or import a pack. These are commands meant for testing over adb.
  - The app now ignores them and shows a short message, unless you turn on **Settings › ADB control (debug)**. That switch is off by default and asks before it turns on. Turn it on only while you use adb.
  - Starting a game from a frontend works as before.

Everything else is as in [0.2.1](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.2.1). The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md).

### Files

- `anka-native-0.2.2.apk`: the app (`dev.ankanative.android`), signed with the release key. Certificate SHA-256: `4d7443354f53a0aef11bc4df1a34ff3fc5bd6d748bbeb76fd78c80a6841f3bb0`. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your saves.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksum of the APK

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.1
releases.body:
### Fixes

- **Prepare on the phone stopped at the end for Ocarina of Time** ([#3](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/3)): "76 of 42346 shaders did not build: no library written".

  The same 76 shaders don't build on a computer either, and the game runs without them. Ocarina of Time's profile was missing the list that tells the phone which shaders those are, so the phone counted them as failures. 0.2.1 adds the list.

  Checked on a computer with the phone's rule: the library is now written, byte for byte the one a computer makes.

  **If your Prepare stopped with this message:** update to 0.2.1, open the game's card and tap **Retry**. The shaders already translated are kept, so it only tries the 76 again and then writes the library.

### New

- **Prepare on a computer on Windows** too, besides Linux and the Mac. Setup: [android/README.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/android/README.md#the-environment).
- **[Discussions](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions)** are open. Tell us how it runs on your phone in the [device reports](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/discussions/1) thread.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.2.0
releases.body:
**Prepare on the phone (experimental).** The app can now make a game's pack from your dump on the phone itself. You no longer need a computer.

### How

Copy your dump (or `.nup`) to the phone, open **Anka Native**, tap **Add game**, pick the dump and tap **Prepare**. The app does three things in the background, with a notification:

1. It rewrites the game's code.
2. It scans the game's files for shaders.
3. It translates the shaders.

When it is done, the game's card says Ready.

- **Keep the phone on a charger.** For Ocarina of Time, preparing takes about 3 hours and uses the CPU fully.
- If a step fails, the card says why. Its log is in `<title ID>-work/ondevice/logs` next to the dump. Preparing on a computer still works as before.

### What was tested

On a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time:

- **Code rewrite:** worked, about 3 minutes.
- **Shader scan:** worked, about 35 minutes for the game's 186,583 files. It found 42,346 shaders, as many as on a computer.

releases.name: Anka Native 0.1.1
releases.body:
A fix for 0.1.0: **Prepare on the phone looked done but made nothing to play.**

0.1.0 was built without the on-phone packer. Its Prepare ran a simulated engine: the progress finished, but the pack it made was an empty placeholder with no game code and no shaders, so Play could not start the game.

### What changed

- Without the on-phone packer, the app no longer offers Prepare. Home and the game's card now say to prepare the game on a computer (the README's [Install](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative#install) steps) and to pick that pack.
- A placeholder pack left by 0.1.0 is no longer shown as ready: the card says "No pack", and Play explains why.

Preparing on the phone itself is being worked on for a later release.

Everything else is as in [0.1.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.1.0): your own dump is needed, the driver is [Anka Turnip 1.0.0](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaTurnip/releases/tag/v1.0.0), and the RAM saver is recommended below 16 GB of RAM. Tested only on a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time.

releases.name: ARMSX2 2.9.5
releases.body: # ARMSX2 2.9.5 What's new: ## Memory cards **Folder memory cards keep every save.** If your memory card's Type is Folder, every save is now written whole. A save made just before you left the app could come back blank or as the older version, because the card was written to storage between the save's data and its file entry; that can no longer happen. A new save that reuses a deleted save's space keeps its own name instead of reappearing under the deleted one's. A save file the device won't open for writing is still read, where the game showed it as damaged. New saves are created on storage that needs Android's own file access with the IOP thread on, and leaving the app rewrites nothing when nothing on the card changed. done by @bmdhacks

releases.name: ARMSX2 2.9.4
releases.body: # ARMSX2 2.9.4 ## New **Vulkan by default.** New installs start on the Vulkan renderer on every device whose driver reports Vulkan 1.1, and on Auto elsewhere. Existing installs keep the renderer they have. Auto now picks Vulkan on every Mali of the Bifrost G31, G51, G52 and G76 generation and of the Valhall generations (G57 to G78, G310 to G710, G615, G715, Immortalis-G715). done by @bmdhacks **MaliSX2 on every Mali it drives.** The GPU Driver list, the GPU card, first-run setup and the driver notice offer MaliSX2 on the Mali-G31, G51, G52 and G76, G57, G68, G77 and G78, G310, G510, G610 and G710, and G615, G715 and Immortalis-G715. The G31, G51 and G310 to G710 need MaliSX2 0.5.0 or newer. done by @bmdhacks

releases.name: ARMSX2 nightly 20261114 (6d9511e29e)
releases.body:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.

## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15: driver recomendado para tu GPU

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.
  - **MediaTek, Exynos, Tensor o Unisoc con Mali-G57 o más nueva:** PanVK (Mesa), con la misma condición.
  - **Mali-G52/G72/G76 o más antiguas:** el driver del sistema (PanVK aún es experimental en ellas).
  - **PowerVR (Moto g54, Helio G35/G37…) y Samsung Xclipse:** el driver del sistema. No hay un driver alternativo que funcione en ellas.
- **Aviso si el driver no es para tu GPU.** Si eliges un driver hecho para otra GPU (por ejemplo, Turnip en una Mali o PanVK en una Adreno), el launcher avisa de que el juego probablemente no arrancará.

La app no incluye ningún driver: los importas tú como ZIP (adrenotools) desde el mismo diálogo.

releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

Revisamos los reportes de la v0.1.13. La protección para GPU PowerVR funcionó: el Moto g54 ya pasa del primer dibujo. Esta versión corrige el cierre más repetido y hace que los reportes traigan la información que necesitamos.

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13: mega actualización

Revisamos uno por uno los reportes y los zip de diagnóstico que nos enviaron. Esta versión corrige los fallos más repetidos y añade lo necesario para que los próximos reportes traigan toda la información.

### Gráficos

- **Detalle de las sombras ya se puede activar.** El juego solo habilita esa opción con tarjetas NVIDIA o ATI. Ahora el port se presenta como una NVIDIA GeForce 7800 GTX, así que la opción se puede subir y las sombras se dibujan en carrera.
- **Texturas DXT1 con transparencia correcta.** Se convierten a A1R5G5B5, como ya hace Carbon: menos memoria y bordes recortados correctos.
- **Protección para GPU PowerVR (MediaTek, p. ej. Moto g54 / Dimensity 7020).** El driver Vulkan de MediaTek se caía al crear el primer pipeline gráfico, en los cuatro juegos. Ahora, si el driver falla, el port reintenta con configuraciones más simples hasta encontrar una que funcione. *No hemos podido probarlo en un teléfono PowerVR; si tienes uno, cuéntanos cómo va.*

### Estabilidad

releases.name: v1.0.10
releases.body:
## EmuFive 1.0.10: cleaner 3D games, Wytchwood fix, screen mode

### What's new
- **No more white dashes and stale pixel blocks in 3D games** (Blue Prince). The PS4 GPU's colour fast clears and its depth and MSAA compression left 8×8-pixel blocks behind when a game read an image back; EmuFive now turns them off. Blue Prince is playable on a PS4 Pro at about 25 FPS.
- **Wytchwood: no more full-screen noise near objects you can interact with.** A new full-screen mask the game reads before drawing it held leftover bytes from other images; it now starts full. Wytchwood is playable on a PS4 Pro at a stable 30 FPS.
- **Screen mode setting for TVs that show a black screen.** EmuFive used the TV's preferred mode, which some TVs offer although the PS4 can't send it (black screen after the PS4 Multiboot menu). Add `emufive.mode=1920x1080@60` to the line in `/data/linux/boot/bootargs.txt` (keep `video=HDMI-A-1:1920x1080@60D` too).
- **A new emulator build** (KytyPS5 589bd14 with EmuFive patches 0001–0034).

### Update
Settings, System, Software update. The PS4 asks to restart after it.

From 1.0.3 or earlier, start the update once by hand (see the README's Changelog).

### New installs

releases.name: v1.0.9
releases.body:
## EmuFive 1.0.9: faster 3D games, video clips, game info

### What's new
- **3D games run much faster.** New GPU-shared game memory puts game memory where the PS4's GPU reads and writes it in place, so buffers are no longer copied, tracked page by page, or read back. Teardown on a PS4 Pro: the menu scene went from 2.1 to 7 FPS, and in game it runs at 9–12 FPS (about 20 in light scenes). It is on by default; if a game hangs or runs out of memory, turn it off in Settings > Games > GPU-shared game memory.
- **Fixes:** Teardown's crash in the main menu (it writes GPU commands from shaders), two crashes in long sessions, and a hang in Invincible VS.
- **Video clips.** PS + Triangle starts recording, in a game too, and PS + Triangle again stops it (720p or 1080p at 30 FPS, with sound, up to 60 minutes). Clips are saved on the PS4 (`~/Videos`) or in `PS5-videos` on a USB drive (Settings > Storage). Media shows and plays them, and Share sends them to your phone like screenshots. The PS4's video encoder can't be used under Linux, so the CPU encodes: about one core for 720p.

releases.name: v1.0.8
releases.body:
## EmuFive 1.0.8: big games run much faster

### What's new
- **Games with very large buffers run much faster.** 1.0.7 uploaded every recently used buffer whole each frame, which for a game like Teardown meant over 3 GB per frame. Now only small buffers (up to 4 MB) are uploaded that way; large ones are tracked by page again. Teardown on a PS4 Pro went from under 1 FPS to about 2.4 FPS. DREDGE keeps its 1.0.7 speed and clean sound.
- **A new emulator build** (KytyPS5 589bd14 with EmuFive patches 0001–0032).

### Teardown and other big games: more GPU memory
Teardown also needs the GPU to be allowed up to 5 GB of system RAM, or it stops with GPU out of memory. Use the `bootargs.txt` of [PS4 Multiboot v1.5.0-beta-5](https://github.com/blue0x1/ps4-multiboot/releases/tag/v1.5.0-beta.5) (copy it to `/data/linux/boot/` over FTP), or add `amdgpu.gttsize=5120 ttm.pages_limit=1310720` to the end of the line in your own.

### Update
Settings, System, Software update. No restart is needed. Coming from 1.0.6 or earlier, it installs 1.0.7 first, which also updates the PS4 Mesa (see the 1.0.7 notes).

From 1.0.3 or earlier, start the update once by hand (see the README's Changelog).

releases.name: v1.0.7
releases.body:
## EmuFive 1.0.7: faster games, smooth cover changes

### What's new
- **Faster games.** The emulator uploads buffers to the GPU in batches and waits on it less often. DREDGE on a PS4 Pro went from about 12 to 13–28 FPS, and 44–50 FPS in lighter views, and its sound no longer crackles.
- **A new emulator build** (KytyPS5 589bd14 with EmuFive patches 0001–0031): better memory use, GPU caches and shader translation, on top of the speed-ups above.
- **Smooth cover changes on the home screen.** Moving between games now changes the cover smoothly. Pick the effect in Settings, Appearance, Motion, Cover change. There are 11: fade, slide, zoom, wipe, dark, parallax, blinds, doors, push, iris and pixelate.
- **New PS4 Mesa.** The update installs the PS4 Mesa of PS4 Multiboot v1.5.0-beta-4, which is needed for all 4 GPU engines on the PS4 Pro (below).

### Update
1. Optional: copy `ps4-mesa.tar.xz` from [PS4 Multiboot v1.5.0-beta-4](https://github.com/blue0x1/ps4-multiboot/releases/tag/v1.5.0-beta.4) to `/user/home/` over FTP. The update takes it from there; without it, the PS4 needs to be online and downloads it (about 45 MB).
2. Settings, System, Software update. No restart is needed.

# WWE '12 PC 1.4.0

The match-options update: new match rules in the menus (starting finishers, squash, I QUIT, Special Guest Referee), a Universe chaos level, Mod Maker additions and fixes for what you reported after 1.3.0.

- **Squash matches.** In **OPTIONS > GAMEPLAY > BALANCING > DAMAGE** (the page now has three new lines): **SQUASH CHANCE** (0-100 %, the chance that a 1 on 1 match is a squash; 0 = off, the default), **SQUASH: JOBBER HEALTH** (starting health of the lower-rated wrestler, 20 % by default) and **STARTING FINISHERS** (default for every match). The lower-rated wrestler is the jobber; the other one starts with a finisher. The labels of the three new lines are in English only.

releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.body:
**WWE '12 PC v1.3.0 — "Speed and fixes"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Faster
- **Loading screens shorter** (a match loads in about 1.5 s instead of 4 s, the end of the entrances in about 1.9 s instead of 4.5 s). `wwe12_fast_loading = false` brings the old behaviour back.
- **Faster start-up** on PCs with 8 or more logical processors: the title screen comes after about 5-7 s instead of 15 s. On smaller processors the normal start-up is kept (`wwe12_fast_boot_min_threads`).
- **Sharper picture** when the game is drawn at 720p on a bigger screen (`svr_upscale_sharpness`, 0 turns it off).
- **Adaptive V-sync**: a late frame is shown at once instead of waiting a whole refresh (`svr_adaptive_vsync`).
- **Performance test** in the launcher (button *Performance test*): it plays a recorded 1-on-1 match with entrances once and tells you if your PC is fine, limited by the processor or by the graphics card. Nothing is changed without your agreement.

### Frame rate

**WWE '12 PC v1.2.0 — "Moveset update"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Fixed
- **Match-start stutter (and a short freeze) on integrated graphics (Intel...)**: the game's reads of the picture back from the graphics card are now grouped at the end of the frame (about 10 times less waiting at the start of a match). `svr_readback_defer_streak = false` goes back to 1.1.
- **Less work for the processor every frame** (helps small PCs, issue #53): shader constants are reused like on Android (`svr_reuse_constant_blocks`) and the check of 3D models is lighter (`svr_geometry_sample_min`, 32768 brings the 1.1 behaviour back).
- **Crash at start with file names that have accents or other characters** (for example a song called "Café.mp3" or a mod folder with Japanese letters in a mod): names are now read as UTF-8 everywhere in the game, the launcher and the Mod Maker, and a mod with an unreadable name is skipped instead of closing the game.
- **Launcher: the MUSIC page closed the launcher** when a file in the `music` folder had an odd name.

releases.name: v1.1.0
releases.body:
**WWE '12 PC v1.1.0**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Fixed
- **Universe: crash with 5 or more matches per weekly show** (RAW / SmackDown set to 5 or 6 matches, especially in the weeks after some PPVs, and the show after WrestleMania). Fixed and tested over several simulated months.
- **Universe: the extra matches no longer repeat "#1 contender" matches** (the same wrestlers twice on one card), and a show set to 6 matches now gets its 6 matches week after week (the game's 7-day rest rule used to drop matches).
- **Direct3D 12 on older Intel graphics (UHD 620): half-transparent wrestlers and ring** fixed (#7). New setting `svr_d3d12_depth_flip` (true by default; `false` = 1.0 behaviour).
- **Damaged / white Superstar Threads attires on slower PCs** fixed (fix adapted from KaikoClanworth1's SvR 2011 PC port).
- **Direct3D 11: broken wrestler skin on old NVIDIA cards such as the GeForce GT 430** fixed (#55; fix adapted from KaikoClanworth1's SvR 2011 PC port).

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.1
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.1 — your settings stay put

A patch release. No new features: **23 defects** found and fixed across five rounds of multi-agent bug hunting, plus a hardware-validation pass on the published packages.

### Settings are saved again

On macOS and on every AppImage, NeoST runs from **read-only media**, so it stores its configuration in your user directory — but it never created that directory, and every setting was silently lost when you closed the emulator. **Five of the eight packages were affected.** Machine profile, video, audio and MIDI setup now survive a restart.

### Also fixed

- **The macOS disk image installs by drag and drop.** It shipped with the app alone, no `Applications` shortcut.
- **The web build ships its licences** (GPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, third-party notices), like every other package.
- **A save-state can no longer be reloaded under a different ROM.** The pairing relied on two bytes of TOS version, which five localisations share, so resuming under the wrong ROM froze the CPU without a word. The state format is now **v19**; v18 and older are refused explicitly, with a message that says why.

# Bloodborne PC 1.9.8.6

What's new since 1.9.8.4.

## Picture fixes
- **Smeared picture fixed (two causes):**
  - After a load, the game sometimes rewrote a command buffer it had already handed to the GPU. The picture then stayed broken or smeared until the game was restarted. - Rainbow tiles on hit enemies and a light line along the top in cutscenes are fixed.

releases.name: Exiled-Kingdoms-Multiplayer-2.0
releases.body:
# 🛡️ [MOD] Exiled Kingdoms LAN Multiplayer — 2.0!

Hey everyone! Another update to the **LAN Multiplayer** mod for Exiled Kingdoms.

Here's the full summary:

---

## ⚔️ NEW — LAN Multiplayer Bug Fixes

### 🐛 Bug: Crash when entering Cities
- **Problem:** When entering some cities, the game would crash and close.
- **Fix:** Problem fixed, and you can now teleport and enter cities perfectly.

### 🐛 Bug: Monsters ignored the CLIENT when the HOST was far away
- **Problem:** Monsters only attacked when the HOST was nearby. If only the CLIENT approached, the monster would remain still.
- **Fix:** Detection now compares the HOST and all CLIENTs present on the same map and returns the **closest** to the monster as the target.

### 🐛 Bug: Incorrect monster level scaling in co-op
- **Problem:** Monsters scaled based on 0+ (extra players). × 2), resulting in level 2 Goblins in a session with 2
- **Correction:** Now uses the Bestiary's `minlevel` as a base before applying the LAN difficulty multiplier. Example: Goblin (base level 4) + 2 players = level 6. Yeti (base level 18) + 2 players = level 22.

### 🐛 Bug: CLIENT couldn't reduce HOST's HP in the PVP Arena

- **Rocky Ridge minecart above 60 Hz (#410, #401).** With **Test options › Gameplay › Race step rate** above 60 (for example 120 or 144):
  - **The cart's lever** no longer ends up hanging upside down under the cart when you lean left and right. At 144 Hz, each lean turned it about 2.4 times too far. After a few leans it had turned all the way round. It now stops where it does at 60 Hz.
  - **The jump into the cart** no longer flies too far. At 144 Hz the racer was put into the cart while still in the air. The jump now lasts about as long as at 60 Hz.
  - Both parts of the course moved by a fixed amount each step, an amount written for steps of one frame. They now move by the right amount for shorter steps. At the default 60 Hz nothing changes.

releases.name: v0.10.64 — Expert courses above 60 Hz: the Final Factory skydive and the Metropolis Speedway launch
releases.body:
## Changes

- **Expert courses above 60 Hz (#410).** With **Test options › Gameplay › Race step rate** above 60 (for example 120 or 144):
  - **Final Factory Expert:** the skydive down the shaft no longer falls too fast or leaves the camera behind. At 144 Hz it fell about 2.4 times as fast, so the drop was over in about 2 seconds; it now lasts as long as at 60 Hz.
  - **Metropolis Speedway Expert:** the launch up the building no longer hangs at the top. At 144 Hz the racer stayed up there about 5.5 seconds instead of 3; it is now about 3.7 seconds.
  - Both were parts of the course that moved the racer by a fixed amount each step, written for steps of one frame; they now move by the right amount for shorter steps. At the default 60 Hz nothing changes.

releases.name: v0.10.63 — Older Mali phones no longer stop with a graphics error
releases.body:
## Changes

- **Older Mali phones (#406).** On phones with an older ARM Mali graphics chip, such as the Galaxy A05 and A06 (Mali-G52), the game no longer stops at start with "native graphics pipeline creation failed".
  - Their graphics driver refused every way of drawing a textured surface the game prepares, because of one feature the game asked for. The game now draws textures in a way that does not need it, and costs nothing extra.
  - Other phones, tablets and computers draw exactly as before.

Everything else is the same as [v0.10.62](https://github.com/YuutaTsubasa/Free-Riders-Recompiled/releases/tag/v0.10.62).

## Validation

- **Galaxy A06 (Mali-G52, the same chip as the A05), the fix's own build:** the graphics self test prepared all 455 ways of drawing (0.10.62: 71), drew with every one of them and read the picture back. This release's APK itself was not run on a Mali device.
- **AYN Thor (Adreno), this release's APK:** the same graphics self test prepared all 455 with none skipped and drew with all of them, so nothing changed on Adreno.

releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.5-dev (versionCode 9).

### Changes

- Added native implementations of selected game, rendering, AI and container algorithms, with the original recompiled paths retained. Optimized guest-register handling, x87 calculations and indirect-call caches.
- Added Optimal (ARM64) and Exact (x86) execution modes. Exact selects the original recompiled algorithms; both modes run as ARM64 code.
- Reduced GLES state traffic between threads, draw preparation work and shader constant uploads, and improved shader program caching.
- Improved launcher operation progress, diagnostics and Play button feedback, with the amber UT3 palette.
- Added an optional 4 GB guest address space, enabled by default on 64-bit devices with at least 5 GiB of RAM.
- Fixed fingerprint sensors being mistaken for gamepads.
- Reduced APK size by stripping non-runtime library symbols while retaining the original library for offline profiling. Expanded regression tests and updated documentation.

### Requirements

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.4.1-dev
releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4.1-dev (versionCode 8).

### Changes

- Improved CPU performance on PhysX Mod Pack maps with native fluid collision kernels, native pair removal and optimized x87 calculations.
- Added on-device HLSL compilation through vkd3d-shader, with shader caching and improved MojoShader compatibility for mod materials.
- Fixed touch aiming: holding Fire no longer blocks another finger's camera movement; dragging from Fire, secondary fire, Jump or Crouch also turns the camera.
- Made the crash monitor a launcher option, disabled by default, to avoid keeping its extra Android process running unless needed.
- Removed FSR3 frame generation. FSR1 spatial upscaling and FXAA remain available.
- Reduced per-draw post-processing overhead and removed temporary qa-flags performance switches.
- Updated localized PhysX and audio setting descriptions.

### Installation and validation

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; compatible Adreno devices can use Turnip.

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.4-dev
releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4-dev.

### Changes

- Added an FPS counter with a frame-time graph and optional system information for every renderer.
- Added FSR1, FXAA, and FSR3.1 frame generation (DXVK, Android 12+; disabled by default).
- Added CPU-based PhysX effects and OpenAL Soft audio through AAudio with EAX 1–5 support.
- Added a maximum-graphics button and fixed persistence of the 3D rendering scale.
- Fixed terrain rendering in OpenGL ES, accelerated DXT decoding, and allowed unused texture mip levels to stream out.
- Improved GPU query handling in GLES and DXVK, including on PowerVR devices.
- Fixed ASTC/ETC2 texture conversion on shared storage on Pixel devices.
- Added a “Firing or aiming” gyroscope mode and persistent crash reports with a separate error window.

### Installation and limitations

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; frame generation requires Android 12+. Frame generation may cause HUD artifacts and adds GPU and memory overhead. A stable 60 FPS at maximum graphics settings is not guaranteed.

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.3-dev
releases.body:
The third release of the native Android ARM64 port of Unreal Tournament 3 improves GLES performance, text editing and graphics cache handling.

### Changes

- Added a dedicated GLES render thread with automatic CPU core selection. Streamed draw uploads, asynchronous query polling and shader program prelinking reduce work on the game thread.
- Added driver-aware graphics cache maintenance: GLES program binaries are invalidated after driver changes, and DXVK keeps the current and newest other pipeline cache for each driver.
- Fixed DXVK scaled vertex formats with a shader fallback for drivers that need it.
- Replaced keyboard-only text entry with an Android editing dialog for game fields, console commands and chat. Existing text can be corrected or cleared; cancellation preserves it, and original character filters remain in effect.
- Added separate weapon-button swipe settings and expanded the in-game Android settings to nine languages: English, Russian, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian and Polish.
- Improved launcher texture status and fixed texture handling, audio and FSINCOS translation. Expanded regression tests and rendering diagnostics.

### Requirements

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 0.2-dev
releases.body:

- Added OpenSpy service and authentication compatibility, and fixed a registry-call crash during online play.
- Prevented startup defaults from overwriting saved profiles and campaign progress before sign-in. Fixed creation of save directories beneath virtual ZIP folders.

## English

**Status:** Playable menus, paddock/garage, and on-track driving on ARM64 Vulkan (`-O3 + ThinLTO`); fixes blown-out bloom / pitch-black 3D scenes caused by `exp_adjust` texture fetch exponent bias and eliminates MSAA resolve log spam.

### Changes
- **SPIR-V texture `exp_adjust` fix (`spirv_translator_fetch.cpp`):** Extract the 6-bit signed `exp_adjust` (bits 13:18) from fetch constant **word 3** instead of **word 4** (which holds `LOD bias` and erroneously scaled non-zero-LOD-bias textures by `2^±bias`, causing extreme bloom blowout and black scenes on track).
- **Automatic shader/pipeline cache invalidation:** Bumped `SpirvShaderTranslator::Modification::kVersion` (`12` → `13`) so existing `.vk.xpso` caches rebuild automatically on update.
- **Resolve log spam fix (`draw.cpp`):** Downgraded `Incorrect resolve sample selected` from `REXGPU_WARN` to `REXGPU_DEBUG` when `gpu_cap_msaa` caps main-scene MSAA to 1x, eliminating per-frame I/O overhead.

releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.13.7

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

GameCube games draw correctly on Adreno phones: the picture is complete, steady and fast.

- **Missing surfaces.** GX's cull mode was the wrong way round, which removed the faces a game wanted to keep: floors
  and walls came out black.
- **A picture that jumped back.** About twelve times a second the window showed an older picture, or black. A game's
  last draw could leave colour writes off, and the window's present now sets the state it depends on.
- **Stray triangles and speed.** Vertex, index and uniform data stream through persistent, fence-protected buffers
  where the driver has `GL_EXT_buffer_storage`. Other drivers keep the previous path.
- **A driver crash at present.** GX textures no longer announce mip levels they do not have, and the window no longer
  samples through the game's last samplers.

Tested on a Galaxy Z Fold8 (Adreno 840) with Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones, at full speed with 1x and close to it
with 2x internal resolution.

**Known problems**

- 4x internal resolution is too heavy for that phone in 3D scenes (about 60 % speed).

A fix release.

> 💡 **Релиз 18.1.0** - *Полное объединённое обновление STORM SWITCH 18.1.0: перенос всех улучшений рендеринга, памяти и производительности в основную ветку - эталонный профиль и видеосинхронизация Absolum, устранение засветов HDR на движке Snowdrop в Mario + Rabbids: Kingdom Battle, векторные шрифты Slug (`usamplerBuffer` + `VK_EXT_texel_buffer_alignment`) и синхронизация DMA в Diablo II: Resurrected, отображение реально используемой оперативной памяти (App RSS / Working Set + системная ОЗУ) на Android и Windows, архитектура HFT MPSC / MVCC / UMA и разреженная память `HostMemory`, встроенное меню читов во время игры и поддержка `EdenPack`, полное устранение вылетов Windows-версии (Qt 6.11.1 + десктопный Vulkan), кэш конвейеров версии 36 и 18-ступенчатый контроль качества.*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые исправления и улучшения (STORM SWITCH 18.1.0)

- 🎮 **[Эталонная совместимость игр: Absolum, Mario + Rabbids и Diablo II: Resurrected]**:

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 18.0.0
releases.body:
> 💡 **Релиз 18.0.0** - *Масштабное обновление стабильности и графического ядра STORM SWITCH 18.0.0: полное устранение вылетов Windows-версии при запуске любых игр и открытии диалоговых окон на базе Qt 6.11.1, аппаратная поддержка целочисленных буферных текстур (`usamplerBuffer`) для векторного рендеринга шрифтов Slug в Diablo II: Resurrected, исправление экспозиции и глобальной памяти SSBO на движке Snowdrop в Mario + Rabbids: Kingdom Battle, расширение пула буферов хранения до 32 слотов (`MAX_SSBOS = 32`), кэш конвейеров версии 26 и 18-ступенчатый анти-регрессионный контроль качества.*

---

- 🖥️ **[Полное устранение вылетов Windows-версии при запуске игр (`storm_design_engine.cpp`, `game_fix_dialog.cpp`)]**:

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 17.9.0
releases.body:
> 💡 **Релиз 17.9.0** - *Комплексное обновление STORM SWITCH 17.9.0: полное соблюдение стандартов Google Play Protect (чистые APK без PHA:Dropper бандлов драйверов, установка через стандартный FileProvider и ACTION_VIEW), отказоустойчивый умный резолвер SmartDns с поддержкой DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare / Google) и динамическим CDN-роутингом, оптимизация Diablo II Resurrected и профилей игр, улучшенная загрузка деконструированных ROM-директорий без учёта регистра, изоляция интерфейса Switch 2, кэш конвейеров версии 25 и 18-ступенчатый анти-регрессионный контроль качества.*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые исправления и улучшения (STORM SWITCH 17.9.0)

- 🛡️ **[Соответствие стандартам Google Play Protect и чистые APK (`Rule 16 & Rule 17`)]**:
  - **Полная очистка assets от драйверов**: удалены любые исполняемые файлы `.so` и архивы драйверов `.zip` из состава APK для исключения ложных срабатываний Google Play Protect (PHA:Dropper). Все необходимые драйверы безопасно управляются и загружаются через встроенный диспетчер драйверов.

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 17.8.0
releases.body:
> 💡 **Релиз 17.8.0** - *Крупное обновление STORM SWITCH 17.8.0: поддержка графических ускорителей Qualcomm Adreno 8xx (Snapdragon 8 Elite / Gen 4) в драйвере Turnip, аппаратный диспетчер Adreno Gen8, встроенный драйвер STORM DRIVER 12.0.0, соответствие требованиям Google Play Protect и бесшовный фоновый установщик обновлений, восстановление эталонного анти-гостинг презентера 14.4.0 и полное прохождение расширенного 17-ступенчатого анти-регрессионного контроля.*

---

### 🚀 Ключевые исправления и улучшения (STORM SWITCH 17.8.0)

- 🎮 **[Поддержка Adreno 8xx, Adreno Gen8 и драйвер STORM DRIVER 12.0.0 (`vulkan_device.cpp`, `GpuDriverHelper.kt`, `00-storm.conf`)]**:
  - **Диспетчеризация Adreno Gen8 (Snapdragon 8 Elite / 8 Gen 4)**: реализовано автоматическое распознавание чипсетов Adreno 8xx и загрузка специализированного драйвера `vulkan.adreno_gen8.so` через adrenotools с защитой завершающего слеша `custom_driver_dir`.
  - **Коррекция FP16 и EDS3 для Turnip Adreno 8xx**: предотвращены сбои рендеринга и мерцание геометрии за счёт отключения несовместимых расширений `shaderFloat16` и `ExtendedDynamicState3` строго вне драйвера Turnip.

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 17.7.0
releases.body:
> 💡 **Релиз 17.7.0** - *Масштабное восстановление эталонной графической точности по результатам полной ревизии против версии `14.4.0`: устранение всех дефектов рендеринга и чёрного экрана начального видеоролика в **Absolum**, полное исправление графики в **Alan Wake Remastered**, **Diablo II: Resurrected**, **Mario + Rabbids: Kingdom Battle** и других играх Switch 1 при 100% сохранении совместимости с играми Switch 2, очистка профилей `GameFixDatabase` и `drirc`, а также внедрение обязательного автоматического 12-ступенчатого анти-регрессионного контроля перед каждым релизом.*
